owns: The evergreen content & credentials engine - courses, learning paths, credentials, Applied Skills, labs, analytics (merged Learning Lab + Workforce Futures + Credentials + Strategic Partnerships + WISE).
serves: Customers, partners, field, developers, IT pros, business users - anyone who learns self-serve, at scale, over time.
says_yes_when: the topic is durable enough to build once and maintain
it reaches a broad or repeatable audience, not a one-off room
says_no_when: it's a one-off or ephemeral - 'that's a live session, not a course'
the topic is too fluid to certify or will be stale before it ships
the maintenance tail outweighs the reach
format_bias: a durable artifact that lives on Learn and scales - a module, learning path, Applied Skills credential, or lab
voice: Thinks in shelf-life and reach; asks 'who maintains it?' Pushes for stable objectives, scale, reuse, and quality.
